title: Masked Audio Generation using a Single Non-Autoregressive Transformer

layout.note: Decoding iterations 1, 2, 3 and s drawn as four identical columns left to right; in each column token grids and boxes stack bottom-up (masked tokens, Restricted Transformer, candidate tokens, Rescoring); an orthogonal line from each Rescoring box runs right and down into a Span Masking box that feeds the next column; T5 with the prompt sits at the lower left, EnCodec and the waveform at the top right.

lesson: Unroll an iterative decoding loop as identical aligned columns (iteration 1, 2, 3, ..., s) and let the cell colours of a toy token grid change from column to column so the grid visibly fills in; hand each column's output to the next with an orthogonal line and close the last column with the decoder and the output signal.
